description: Cream Finance suffered a $130 million exploit combining flash loans with ERC777 reentrancy. The attacker used multiple flash loans across MakerDAO and AAVE to accumulate massive ETH. They leveraged AMP token which is ERC777-compatible with transfer hooks to perform reentrancy on Cream lending contract. During AMP token transfer callback tokensReceived, the attacker reentered Cream borrow function before balances were updated. By combining flash loaned funds as collateral with reentrancy to borrow multiple times against same collateral, they drained the protocol. This demonstrates how DeFi composability amplifies attack surface when contracts fail to account for external call reentrancy risks.
